data.body_html:
Planning a marbella boat rental hen party budget 2030 doesn’t have to be stressful. With clear pricing, no hidden fees, and options for every group size, you can celebrate your best friend’s last fling before the ring without breaking the bank. This breakdown covers boat hire, food, drinks, decorations, and extras, all departing from Puerto Banús.

Why Choose a Boat for a Hen Party in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline is made for celebration. A private boat gives you total freedom: swim in crystal-clear coves like Cala del Faro, sunbathe on deck, and sip cava as you cruise past the Golden Mile. No crowded bars, no set itineraries. Plus, Puerto Banús is the perfect launch point for a day that ends with dinner at a chiringuito or a night at Pangea. For a full overview of options, see our boat rental Marbella hub.

Boat Options and Hire Costs

Your biggest cost is the boat itself. Here’s how the fleet breaks down for hen parties:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for 8 hours. Fits 9-11 guests. Ideal for budget-conscious groups who want a full day on the water.
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white or grey): €4,719 minimum 4 hours. Includes a free jet ski. Perfect for a premium experience with up to 12 guests.
  • Other boats (e.g., Azimut 58 Flybridge, Ferretti 94, Canados 86): Pricing on request via WhatsApp. These are for groups that want maximum space and luxury.

All prices include skipper, fuel, insurance, and 21% IVA. No surprises.

Food and Catering Budget

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For a hen party, you’ll likely want more. Budget €20-€40 per person for catering. Options include:

  • Platters from local delis (jamón, cheese, olives, bread) – €15-€25 per person.
  • Sushi or tapas boxes – €25-€40 per person.
  • Bring your own cupcakes, cake, or party snacks.

Most groups bring extra prosecco or a signature cocktail. Confirm with the team if you need a cooler or extra fridge space.

Decorations and Extras

Hen parties love personal touches. Budget €50-€150 for decorations: banners, balloons, matching T-shirts, or a “Bride-to-Be” sash. You’re welcome to decorate the boat yourself. Some groups also hire a photographer for €200-€400 for a couple of hours. Inflatables (swim platforms, unicorn floats) are easy to bring along.

Economy option uses a Tier A boat; premium uses a Tier B boat with jet ski. Adjust for your group size.

When to Book for 2030

Summer weekends book up fast. For June through September 2030, we recommend booking at least 3-4 months in advance, especially for Saturdays. Weekdays have more availability and sometimes lower demand. To lock in your date, contact us via WhatsApp.

What’s Included in Every Charter

Every boat rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, and a selection of drinks and light snacks. You don’t need a boating license. The skipper will take you to the best spots for swimming and sightseeing along the coast from Puerto Banús to Estepona or Sotogrande.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest boat for a hen party in Marbella?

The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are the most affordable, starting at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks.

Can we bring our own food and decorations?

Yes, you can bring your own catering and decorations. Many hen parties order platters from local caterers (€20-€40 per person) or bring cupcakes and banners. Just confirm with the booking team beforehand to ensure fridge space.

How many guests can fit on a hen party boat?

Our fleet ranges from 5 pax (Dubhe or Mariah SX21) up to 12 pax (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). For most hen parties of 10-12 guests, we recommend the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) or Mangusta 80 (12 pax).

Is a skipper included in the price?

Yes, every charter includes a licensed skipper. You don’t need a boating license. The skipper handles navigation, anchoring, and safety, so you can relax and enjoy the party.

What drinks are included on board?

All charters include water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava. For hen parties, many groups also bring extra prosecco or cocktails. You can also order a premium drinks package via WhatsApp before departure.

How far in advance should we book for summer 2030?

We recommend booking at least 3-4 months ahead for weekends in June, July, August, and September. Peak dates (especially Saturdays) sell out quickly. Weekdays are easier to secure with shorter notice.

What is the total budget for a 4-hour hen party for 10 guests?

A typical 4-hour charter on the Azimut 39 (11 pax) costs €1,499 (2h) or €2,299 (8h). Add €200-€300 for catering and decorations. Total per person: roughly €150-€250, depending on extras.

Can we swim and anchor near the coast?

Yes, your skipper will take you to calm coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where you can swim, snorkel, and use inflatables. The Mangusta 80 even includes a free jet ski for 4-hour+ charters.
